recipe_title: PR #42578 — Market filter modal design validation

ac_coverage.reason: 6/6 ACs PROVEN with assertion + screenshot evidence

assertion_rigor.reason: Each AC uses eval_sync assertions checking specific DOM state (class names, text content, computed styles) — would fail if PR reverted

forbidden_patterns.reason: No switch defaults routing around ACs, no skip evals, all waits ≤500ms, node IDs properly prefixed

flow_reuse.reason: navigate-perps-tab flow not used due to needing /perps/market-list route; used eval_sync navigation instead

screenshot_evidence.reason: 3 screenshots covering all 6 ACs: sort modal design (AC1-5), selection change (AC5), filter dropdown (AC6)

better_version_guidance: Use wait_for with expression instead of fixed wait+assert for navigation. The Playwright locator approach (press/wait_for with test_id) had reliability issues with this extension's modal rendering; eval_sync clicks were more reliable.
